import json,runpy,time,sys
from pathlib import Path
from dataclasses import asdict
import os
from spacepdhcg.gtoc12.low_thrust import ScvxSettings,solve_leg,certify_leg
fixture=runpy.run_path('tests/test_gtoc12_gpu_discretisation.py')
rows=[]
for repeat in range(2):
    start=time.perf_counter()
    solution=solve_leg(fixture['synthetic_boundary'](),ScvxSettings(discretisation_backend='cuda',
        assembly_backend='cuda',convex_solver_backend='qoco',outer_loop_backend=os.environ['SCVX_OUTER'],max_iterations=30,time_limit_s=30))
    seconds=time.perf_counter()-start
    certificate=certify_leg(solution)
    rows.append(dict(warmup=repeat==0,seconds=seconds,status=solution.status,mass=solution.final_mass_kg,
        qualified=bool(solution.converged and certificate.within_tolerance and abs(solution.final_mass_kg-2445.3111007852112)<=1e-5),
        certificate=asdict(certificate),outer_transfer_bytes=solution.outer_transfer_bytes,seed_backend=solution.seed_backend,reports=solution.solver_reports,history=solution.history))
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
print(rows[-1]['qualified'],rows[-1]['seconds'],flush=True)
